class.name: GDCubismEffect
class.brief_description: Base node for legacy Cubism effects.
class.description: Base class for effect children of [GDCubismUserModel]. [member active] controls participation in model evaluation. Use [CubismEffect] for custom effects on the preferred [CubismModel2D] node.

members.member: When this value is [code]true[/code], the [code]_cubism_prologue[/code], [code]_cubism_process[/code], [code]_cubism_epilogue[/code] functions are called.
